name: Autolane
leadership: Ben Seidl (co-founder & CEO), Andy Seidl (co-founder & CPO)
about: Curbside "air traffic control" OS coordinating AV pickup/dropoff for delivery and robotaxi fleets, orchestrating the last fifty feet where autonomous commerce meets crowded curbs, drive-throughs and parking lots.
financing: $7.4M co-led by Draper Associates and Hyperplane, with LAUNCH and Feld Ventures
signal: Expanded to 10 shopping centers; Miami/LA planned (2026)
